name: Dificultad económica
trigger: The customer says they lost their job, are sick, have a family emergency, or cannot afford their payments right now.
content:
1. Acknowledge the situation with empathy in one or two short sentences. Do not pressure, do not mention consequences, and do not ask for details about their health or family.
2. If identity is not verified yet, run [procedure id="${procedure:verificacion_identidad}" name="Verificación de identidad"] first.
3. Run [procedure id="${procedure:acuerdo_pago}" name="Acuerdo de pago"]. The customer described hardship, so hardship_option may be offered, and it should be one of the two plans you present.
4. If get_payment_options returns no hardship_option, or the customer says no option is realistic for them, do not insist and do not improvise amounts. Run [procedure id="${procedure:escalamiento}" name="Escalamiento a asesor"] so an advisor can review relief options.
